description: A focused yet weary Chinese engineer, wearing a neat beige jacket, a blue shirt, and a lanyard badge with dark-rimmed glasses and tidy black hair. He maintains a calm exterior, but hints of deep fatigue linger from endless coding sessions. | 一位专注但神色疲惫的华人工程师，身着整洁的米色外套、蓝色衬衫、佩戴工牌，戴着黑框眼镜，留着整齐的黑发。他保持着冷静的外表，但在无休止的代码编写中仍隐约流露出深层的倦怠。
